title: maintenance of Eaton/Cooper Switches and Transformers
agency: NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION.NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION.NASA SHARED SERVICES CENTER
description_text: NASA has a requirement for the maintenance of Eaton/Cooper Switches and Transformers at Building 9325, National Center for Critical Information Processing and Storage (NCCIPS) Complex, located at Stennis Space Center, MS. See the attached Statement of Work and RFQ document for full details of the requirement. Telephone questions shall not be accepted.
